title_en: DN Cultural Foundation Scholarship 2027, College of Engineering: Call for Applicants (Extended)
summary: Undergraduate students currently enrolled who are interested in the production and manufacturing field and meet the eligibility requirements may apply for the 2027 DN Cultural Foundation Scholarship through the College of Engineering. Applicants must complete the required documents and send them by email by 16:00 on Friday, 13 November 2026 (extended deadline); the email address is given in the original notice. Selected scholars must attend the award ceremony in February 2027 and the ceremony in November 2027.
applies_to: Optional; for interested undergraduate students currently enrolled (재학생), from any department (no department restriction; the call is issued by the College of Engineering), who are interested in the production and manufacturing field, have a grade point average of 3.3/4.3 or higher in the previous semester, have at least two semesters of study remaining, and have never previously been selected for this scholarship.

dates.what: Extended deadline to email the completed application documents
Departments' submission of recommended students (recommendation list and all submitted documents), as stated in the selection procedure
College of Engineering document review and first-round selection of recommended students
Foundation document review and selection of scholars; final selection results announced
Scholarship payment period for selected scholars (KRW 400,000 per month for 10 months)
Award ceremony; attendance is mandatory for selected scholars
Ceremony (시무식); attendance is mandatory for selected scholars

conditions: Applicants must be undergraduate students currently enrolled who are interested in the production and manufacturing field; there is no department restriction.
Applicants must have a grade point average of 3.3/4.3 or higher in the previous semester.
Applicants must have at least two semesters of study remaining.
Students who have previously been selected for this scholarship are not eligible.
There is no limit on the number of applicants, but the College of Engineering plans to recommend up to 15 students and the foundation plans to select about 5.

If more than 15 students apply, eligible applicants will be evaluated on a combined score of grades and interest in the production and manufacturing field; ties are broken by previous-semester GPA and then by credits completed in the previous semester.
If no reply is received by the deadline, it will be treated as having no recommended students.
Being recommended by the College of Engineering does not guarantee final selection as a scholar.
The scholarship may be received together with scholarships from other organisations.
Selected scholars must attend the award ceremony (February 2027) and the ceremony (시무식, November 2027).
Applicants must read the 'Main Activities and Conditions for Maintaining the Scholarship' section in the attached announcement; this attachment was not read for this translation.
steps: Read the attached announcement (DN문화재단 장학생 모집 안내문), including the section 'Main Activities and Conditions for Maintaining the Scholarship'; the attachment content was not read for this translation.
Check that you meet all eligibility requirements.

Download and complete the attached forms: the Scholarship Application Form and Consent Form (foundation form, DN문화재단 장학생 지원 신청서 및 동의서) and the Consent to Collection, Use and Provision of Personal Information (College of Engineering form, 개인정보 수집 이용 및 제공 동의서(공대)).
Obtain your academic transcript ('26.1 기준, as the notice writes it) and certificate of enrolment.
Email all documents to the address given in the original notice by 16:00 on Friday, 13 November 2026.
If selected, attend the award ceremony in February 2027 and the ceremony (시무식) in November 2027.
translation:
2027 College of Engineering DN Cultural Foundation Scholarship: Call for Applicants (deadline extended to Friday 11.13)

The College of Engineering will select 2027 DN Cultural Foundation scholars as follows. Interested students should complete the relevant documents and send them to [email address given in the original notice] by 16:00 on Friday, 13 November 2026.

* Be sure to check the eligibility requirements.

A. Number of recommendations: no limit. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend up to 15 students, and the foundation plans to select about 5.

B. Recommendation requirements
1) Undergraduate students currently enrolled who are interested in the production and manufacturing field. ※ No department restriction.
2) Grade point average of 3.3/4.3 or higher in the previous semester, with at least two semesters of study remaining.
3) Students with no previous history of selection for this scholarship.

C. Scholarship amount: study incentive of KRW 4,000,000 per year (paid as KRW 400,000 per month for 10 months, March to December 2027).
※ May be received together with scholarships from other organisations.

D. Selection procedure
1) Recommendation of candidates by each department (recommendation list and all submitted documents): Thursday, 5 November 2026.
※ If no reply is received by the deadline, it will be treated as having no recommended students.
※ If applications exceed the College of Engineering's recommendation quota (15 students), applicants meeting the basic eligibility requirements will be evaluated on a combined score of grades and interest in the production and manufacturing field. In case of a tie, candidates will be ranked by previous-semester GPA and then by credits completed in the previous semester.
2) College of Engineering document review and first-round selection of recommended students: during November 2026.
3) Foundation document review and selection of scholars: during December 2026.

E. Required documents: Scholarship Application Form (foundation form), academic transcript (as of Spring 2026), certificate of enrolment, Consent to Collection, Use and Provision of Personal Information (foundation and university).

F. Notes
- Please be advised in advance that students recommended by the College of Engineering may not be finally selected as scholars.
- Please read the 'Main Activities and Conditions for Maintaining the Scholarship' section in the announcement.
- Final selection results will be announced during December 2026 through the foundation's selection procedure.
- Selected scholars must attend the award ceremony (February 2027) and the ceremony (시무식, November 2027).

Attachments (4) (the content of the attachments was not read for this translation):
- DN Cultural Foundation Scholarship Announcement (DN문화재단 장학생 모집 안내문 (1).docx)
- DN Cultural Foundation Scholarship Application Form and Consent Form (template) (DN문화재단 장학생 지원 신청서 및 동의서(양식).docx)
- Consent to Collection, Use and Provision of Personal Information (College of Engineering) (개인정보 수집 이용 및 제공 동의서(공대) (8).hwp)
- Scholarship Recommendation List (장학생 추천명단 (4).xlsx)
